data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off deviation of GBP 1.3 million was experienced in 2014 (2013: GBP 6.4 million surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 2.0 million on direct business (2013: GBP 3.4 million surplus) and a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2013: GBP 3.0 million surplus).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a small net favourable prior-year development in 2014, with a reported surplus run-off deviation of GBP 1.3m (release). This arose from a GBP 2.0m release on direct business, primarily driven by improvements in the fire and other damage to property book, partially offset by a GBP 0.7m adverse movement on reinsurance accepted business driven by deterioration in the casualty book.
raw_causal_phrases: A surplus run-off deviation of GBP 1.3 million was experienced in 2014 (2013: GBP 6.4 million surplus).

This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 2.0 million on direct business (2013: GBP 3.4 million surplus) and a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2013: GBP 3.0 million surplus).

The direct improvements primarily arose from the fire and other damage to property books and the reinsurance accepted deteriorations primarily arose from a deterioration on the casualty book although this was partly offset by a surplus on the property book (2013: the direct and reinsurance accepted surpluses primarily arose from the fire and other damage to property books).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development derived from the narrative 'Movement in prior year provision for claims outstanding' note which provides explicit gross amounts (GBP 2.0m direct surplus and GBP 0.7m reinsurance deficit) summing to a net GBP 1.3m surplus; opening gross claims outstanding taken from the balance sheet (2013 closing = 72,176k). No explicit gross claims development triangle was found; some LOB attributions are inferred from narrative rather than quantified per LOB.
